question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH distinct_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id, birth_date
    FROM mst_users
),
with_age AS (
    SELECT user_id, birth_date,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CAST(birth_date AS DATE))) AS age_years
    FROM distinct_users
),
categorized AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           CASE
               WHEN age_years BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
               WHEN age_years BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
               WHEN age_years BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
               WHEN age_years BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
               ELSE 'others'
           END AS age_category
    FROM with_age
)
SELECT age_category, COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM categorized
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category
